title: Number of blank and questionable ballots; record of.
bodyText: In addition to the count of the valid ballots, the voter service center officials shall, as to each separate official ballot, also determine and record the number of totally blank ballots and the number of questionable ballots.
bodyHtml: §16-27  Number of blank and questionable ballots; record of.  In addition to the count of the valid ballots, the voter service center officials shall, as to each separate official ballot, also determine and record the number of totally blank ballots and the number of questionable ballots. [L 1970, c 26, pt of §2; am L 1973, c 217, §6(e); am L 2021, c 213, §42]
